fields.sensor: Sentinel-2, Landsat or Modis (Copernicus: the elevation model of catalog.EXTRA; MERIT Hydro: the hydrography of its topographic wetness index; RESOLVE: the ecoregions and biomes of RESOLVE Ecoregions 2017)
fields.col: Earth Engine collection (LANDSAT = Landsat 5, 7, 8 and 9; RESOLVE/ECOREGIONS/2017, a collection of polygons)
fields.band: band of the fixed layers (of a collection of polygons, the property of its features that the layer gives: ECO_ID, BIOME_NUM)
fields.ft: formula: a band, an expression of the bands, N(b1,b2) for the normalized difference, SCF(green,nir,swir1) for the snow of the snow cover frequency (sensors.SCF), or TWI(elevation band,upstream area band) for the topographic wetness index of MERIT Hydro, TWI(elv,upa) (sensors.TWI)
fields.sea: with data over the open sea (the regions sea and sea_at, the oceans and seas of the IHO): the others are of the land, with no data offshore (Sentinel-2 and Landsat see the coastal waters only); the tools warn when one of them is computed over a sea
fields.static: fixed layer, without dates (catalog.EXTRA: elevation, slope, topographic wetness index, the bioclimatic variables of WorldClim, the ecoregions and biomes): an image (col and band, with terrain slope; the topographic wetness index from two bands, see ft) or polygons rasterized (with classes), with maps and their statistics but no time series, trends or comparisons
fields.classes: categorical fixed layer (catalog.EXTRA: ECOREGION and BIOME): the key of its table in classes (the code, name and colour of each class); its values are class codes, not quantities: never interpolated nor averaged (nearest neighbour; on pixels more than twice as big as m, the majority class, mode), its statistic over a region the majority class, the area of each class (area_by_class), zones by class and where conditions with classes (the classes to keep) or exclude (those to leave out); see monitoreo.categorical
fields.references: articles of the formula or algorithm of the variable (their IDs in references)

notes.ft: Model of the small high-mountain lakes of Sierra Nevada (Spain), oligo-mesotrophic (0.03 to 4.5 mg m-3 in its 56 samples of 2020, 2021 and 2023): Table 3b of Llodrà-Llabrés et al. (2026, https://doi.org/10.1029/2026WR043523), a linear model of the surface reflectance of B12, B4 and B8, each standardized with the mean and standard deviation of the samples (the constants of the formula, which the data of the article give: https://www.hydroshare.org/resource/36d2115b22c144d4ab3f08d3e21245a8). Only valid on the water of such lakes, best 40 to 60 m from the shore and worse closer than about 20 m: over land, other waters or the shore its values (even below 0) are not chlorophyll. Nor on water altered by Saharan dust: the article left out its samples of 2022, of an extreme dust deposition, and on them the model gives 0.4 to 17.8 mg m-3 where 0.02 to 2.8 were measured. Values above about 4.5 mg m-3, the highest of its samples, are outside its calibration. Calibrated with Sentinel-2 corrected with 6SV; here, the Sen2Cor reflectance of COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED.

ecoregions.name: Ecoregions of RESOLVE Ecoregions 2017
ecoregions.notes: The 846 terrestrial ecoregions of RESOLVE Ecoregions 2017 (Dinerstein et al. 2017) and Rock and Ice (ECO_ID 0): for each ECO_ID, its ECO_NAME, its COLOR (lower-case hex, without #) and its biome (that of the data, BIOME_NUM, as it is; Rock and Ice, 99, a code of MonitorEO). Taken from the attribute table of the shapefile of RESOLVE (https://ecoregions.appspot.com/, CC BY 4.0), as its web map and the copy of Esri give it; the names with their accents. The colours of 8 ecoregions (ECO_ID 204, 245, 259, 286, 316, 317, 453 and 763) in the Earth Engine asset may be older: the example of the dataset in the Earth Engine catalog sets them to these.

biomes.name: Biomes of RESOLVE Ecoregions 2017
biomes.notes: The 14 biomes of RESOLVE Ecoregions 2017 (BIOME_NUM, BIOME_NAME and COLOR_BIO of the data, the colours in lower-case hex without #) with their names in Spanish, and Rock and Ice (99), a code of MonitorEO, as in the WWF terrestrial ecoregions of 2001: in the data, ECO_ID 0 Rock and Ice has BIOME_NUM 11, the number of Tundra, and BIOME_NAME N/A, so it would merge into Tundra; its colour, ffeaaf, is that of the legend of the web map of RESOLVE. The biome of each ecoregion is that of the data, as it is: e.g. ECO_ID 316 Godavari-Krishna mangroves is in biome 13 (Deserts & Xeric Shrublands), and the data have 58 ecoregions in biome 7 and 102 in biome 13 (Table 1 of the article: 57 and 103).
